g.text: St. Alban Academy: proposed stair sections
S02 dimensions only. Full-run architectural voids plus editor world-ground opening remain to be built and tested.
main-stair to upper-main-stair - OPEN_ROUTE
Rise 3.6 m / run 5.76 m / clear width 1.5 m
20 risers, 0.180 m each (proposed)
1.5 m landing reservations at both ends
Cyan: 2.2 m headroom envelope above flight
Floor/roof depth and underside rays require actual geometry
east-stair to upper-east-stair - OPEN_ROUTE
Rise 3.6 m / run 5.76 m / clear width 1.5 m
20 risers, 0.180 m each (proposed)
1.5 m landing reservations at both ends
Cyan: 2.2 m headroom envelope above flight
Floor/roof depth and underside rays require actual geometry
cellar-stair to main-stair - OPEN_ROUTE
Rise 3 m / run 4.8 m / clear width 1.3 m
18 risers, 0.167 m each (proposed)
1.5 m landing reservations at both ends
Cyan: 2.2 m headroom envelope above flight
Floor/roof depth and underside rays require actual geometry
